subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Half a million dollars is only a __drop in the bucket__ to what is required for this industry.

options.text: unity and functioning together to achieve a goal
A very small part of something big or whole
a person or situation having no hope of positive change

solution:
The correct answer is **__A very small part of something big or whole__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of this idiom is a **very small amount in comparison to the amount required.**
 
• This **idiom is used **when someone have to compare a small amount with amount needed.
 
• **Example** : Everything we raised was a **drop in the bucket.**
 
• The meaning of above idiom matches with **Option 3, hence option 3 is answer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Some more idioms are:

 
• **Hit the hay** - go to sleep

Example : I am feeling like I really need to **hit the hay.**

 
• **Up in the air** - unsettles or uncertain

Example : My plan of meeting my boyfriend is still **up in the air.**

 
• **Piece of cake** - easy to gain

Example : German is my **piece of cake.**
